title: 四位数码管动态扫描
goal: 掌握共阳数码管的段码原理与动态扫描显示（分时点亮 + 视觉暂留）。
doc:
实验平台（虚实结合）：本课程实物实验采用 STC89C52RC 最小系统板（京东开发板）与 STM32F407 最小系统板（京东开发板）。 本虚拟仿真实验基于上述最小系统板构建，可灵活扩展外设（LED、按键、上拉电阻、蜂鸣器、矩阵键盘、数码管、LCD1602、串口适配器等），是实物实验的有益补充——虚实结合、线上线下实验类似但不完全重复。

实验原理

共阳数码管：公共端（位选）接高电平选中，段（a~dp）低电平点亮。 4 位数码管共用 8 根段线，靠快速轮流点亮每一位（每位约 2ms）实现"同时显示"——这是动态扫描。

接线表

数码管单片机
a b c d e f g dpP0.0 ~ P0.7
位选 D1~D4P2.0 ~ P2.3

实验步骤

  1. 编译下载，观察计数器递增显示
  2. 把计数值改大观察显示范围
  3. 对照段码表理解 0xC0 为什么显示 "0"（二进制 1100_0000 → a、b 段灭）

思考

1. 若扫描间隔从 2ms 改为 50ms 会看到什么现象？
2. 段码表的值是怎么算出来的？试推导数字 "1" 的段码。
3. 为什么 P0 接数码管要加上拉排阻？（P0 是漏极开路输出，输出 1 时引脚悬空）
goalEn: Common-anode 7-segment codes and dynamic scanning (time-multiplexed lighting + persistence of vision).
docEn:
Experiment platform (virtual–physical): the physical labs in this course use the STC89C52RC minimal system board (JD.com) and the STM32F407 minimal system board (JD.com). This virtual experiment is built on the same boards and can be extended with peripherals (LEDs, buttons, pull-up resistors, buzzer, matrix keypad, 7-segment displays, LCD1602, UART adapter, etc.) — a useful complement to the physical labs: similar but not identical.

Principle

Common-anode display: the common pin (digit select) is driven high to enable a digit; segments a–dp light when low. The 4 digits share 8 segment lines; lighting each digit in turn very quickly (about 2ms per digit) creates the illusion of simultaneous display — that is dynamic scanning.

Wiring

DisplayMCU
a b c d e f g dpP0.0 ~ P0.7
Digit selects D1–D4P2.0 ~ P2.3

Steps

  1. Build and flash; watch the counter increment on the display
  2. Increase the count limit and observe the display range
  3. Use the segment table to work out why 0xC0 shows "0" (binary 1100_0000 → segments a and b off)

Reflection

1. What would you see if the scan interval went from 2ms to 50ms?
2. How were the segment-table values derived? Try deriving the code for digit "1".
3. Why does P0 need pull-up resistors to drive the display? (P0 is open-drain; a pin floats when outputting 1)
